parameters.query: WITH purged AS (DELETE FROM vector_person v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.documentId = COALESCE(v.metadata->>'documentId', v.metadata->>'numero_documento')) RETURNING 1) SELECT documentType::text AS "documentType", documentId AS "documentId", firstName AS "firstName", secondName AS "secondName", lastNames AS "lastNames", birthdate::text AS "birthdate", genre::text AS "genre" FROM person ORDER BY documentId;

parameters.jsCode: const months=['ene','feb','mar','abr','may','jun','jul','ago','sep','oct','nov','dic']; const genres={MASCULINO:'Masculino',FEMENINO:'Femenino',NO_BINARIO:'No binario',PREFIERO_NO_REPORTAR:'Prefiero no reportar'}; const now=new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 3600 * 1000); const out=[]; for (const item of $input.all()) { const d=item.json; if (!d || !d.documentId) continue; const b=new Date(`${d.birthdate}T00:00:00Z`); let age=now.getUTCFullYear()-b.getUTCFullYear(); if (now.getUTCMonth()<b.getUTCMonth() || (now.getUTCMonth()===b.getUTCMonth() && now.getUTCDate()<b.getUTCDate())) age--; age=Math.max(0, age); const date=`${String(b.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}-${months[b.getUTCMonth()]}-${b.getUTCFullYear()}`; const names=[d.firstName,d.secondName,d.lastNames].filter(Boolean).join(' '); const content=`Persona: ${names}. Documento: ${d.documentType} ${d.documentId}.\nFecha de nacimiento: ${date} (${age} años). Género: ${genres[d.genre]||d.genre}.`; out.push({json:{...d,content}}); } return out;

parameters.query: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM vector_person WHERE metadata->>'documentId' = $1 OR metadata->>'numero_documento' = $1 RETURNING 1) INSERT INTO vector_person(content,embedding,metadata) VALUES ($2,$3::vector,jsonb_build_object('documentId',$1,'numero_documento',$1,'documentType',$4));
